scope: Exercise real POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND frame decoding, child publication, and source-map coverage joins for a 512-vertex locally generated entity across all existing scratch-roundtrip versions.

generatedCases: Two-vertex POLYLINE in a named block.
512-vertex POLYLINE in modelspace; its 512 source coordinates are generated deterministically from scratch.
assertions: Writer records exact parent, vertex, and SEQEND handles for all three chains.
The production reader returns all three exact chains through addPolyline in every version.
The 512-vertex callback has the expected first and last coordinates and a nonzero SEQEND handle.
Each expected chain member has exactly one source-located entity publication and exactly one Published coverage row matching its source offset, map ordinal, and offset space.
implementation.orderingNote: The high-cardinality POLYLINE is emitted last so its automatically allocated vertex handles do not consume the existing test's later fixed entity identities.

limits: Same-library writer→reader integration is not independent-producer interoperability.
Only the locally generated 2-vertex and 512-vertex 2D POLYLINE shapes are covered; this does not qualify all compound entities or all child counts.
No general format support, native CAD behavior, allocator/RSS limit, or performance claim follows.

planImpact.next: Continue the 7BA allocator/accounting audit and broaden locally generated end-to-end shapes only where they close a specific plan row; keep independent-producer and native qualifications distinct.

worktree.reason: The checkout contains extensive unrelated and mixed changes; no safe isolated commit was available.
